Name: Medieval HxW Winery
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
So, way back in the wayback, there was a mod called Sauvignon in Stardew. DoctorDDub made a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6448]Medieval Reskin[/url] for the winery that came with it, which I loved. DoctorDDub gave me permission to tweak it for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32163]HxW Buildable Winery[/url], and Hime kindly gave me permission to release it! So, here's a medieval style winery reskin!

﻿Installation is simple, just download, drag and drop over your existing HxW Buildable Winery mod, and allow to overwrite.

Enjoy!
